info.name: pphat-registry-stats
info.description:
Requests for the @pphatdev/registry telemetry backend (Cloudflare Worker + D1).

**Base URL** is read from the `host` collection variable (default: `https://pphat-telemetry.pphatdev.workers.dev`). Override directly in Collection Variables to point at a self-hosted worker.

**Auth**: only `Admin Reset` requires a bearer token. Set `admin_token` in Collection Variables — matching the wrangler secret configured with `wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN`.

**Anon ID**: the `anon_id` collection variable is a 16-char hex string used to identify ingest payloads. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 8`. Only relevant for the `Ingest Event` request.

request.description:
Liveness + D1 connectivity probe.

- `200 {status:'ok', db:'ok'}` — worker up, D1 reachable.
- `503 {status:'degraded', db:'error', error:...}` — worker up, D1 unreachable.

query.description: Optional rolling window in days. Omit for all-time.

request.description: Returns `{ rows: [[name, count], ...] }` deduplicated per (anon_id, name, day). Heavy users don't skew the count.

query.description: Optional rolling window in days. Omit for all-time.

request.description: Same shape as Top Icons but scoped to `add-component` / `add-comp` events.
Top 50 icons across the whole dataset (no `days` filter).

Simulates what the CLI POSTs after an `add-icon` or `add-component` run.

- `ts` is filled in from a pre-request script.
- `id` uses the `anon_id` collection variable — set it to a 16-char hex string.
- Other commands (stats, list, config, init) are acknowledged with `200 'ok'` but not stored — only `add-icon`, `add`, `add-component`, `add-comp` insert rows.
- Rate limit: 60 requests / 60s per client IP.
Sanity check: proves the worker accepts (200 'ok') but does NOT persist events for commands other than add-icon/add-component. Handy when validating that the classifier is behaving.

header.description: Value of the ADMIN_TOKEN secret set via `wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN`.

request.description:
DESTRUCTIVE — deletes every row in `events` and `event_names`. Requires the correct bearer token or returns 401.

Equivalent to `pphat stats --reset-remote` on the CLI. Not rate-limited; still, don't hammer it.

variable.description: Base URL of the telemetry worker. Override in Collection Variables for self-hosted deployments.
Bearer token for the Admin Reset endpoint. Set via `wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN` on the worker side.
